pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Red wire. Use 3V3 so TX stays at 3.3 V

pins.name: RX
pins.notes: Yellow wire. Mode select: HIGH or open = processed value, LOW = real-time value

pins.name: TX
pins.notes: UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (9600 baud). White wire

sources.title: DFRobot SEN0311 A02YYUW wiki
sources.section: Supply 3.3 to 5 V; UART 9600 baud; range 3 to 450 cm; wires red VCC, black GND, yellow RX, white TX
